scope: Read-only exact-name review of blank-name SFA records at Jewel Changi Airport and Changi Airport Terminal 1 public area. Prioritize current property/operator directories, matching exact postal code and unit. Do not alter public-access or closure status.

source_set.publisher: Jewel Changi Airport Devt Pte. Ltd.
source_set.notes: The directory is current, contains outlet-specific pages and states that operating hours may change. The proposed names below were matched to individual official outlet pages, not the directory landing page alone.
Current official dining directory covers public and transit areas separately. The VE/LA detail page explicitly marks its T1 outlet as PUBLIC.

proposals.source_evidence: Jewel's current official outlet detail names The 1872 Clipper Tea Co. and lists Store Location #02-237. Workbook SFA licence SE19303L000 has the same postal code and exact unit at Jewel.
proposals.match_rationale: Exact SFA licence-to-workbook row; exact mall, postal code and unit match against current official mall outlet detail.
proposals.limitations: Name-only proposal. No other fields or SFA public-access status changed.

held_records.reason: A Jewel official promotional source listed Naixue at #B1-243 in 2025, but no current 2026 official outlet detail for Naixue at that unit was found. The current official Jewel dining pages searched did not confirm it; hold rather than reuse historical tenant evidence.
Current official Jewel listing identifies Food Republic at #B2-238/239/240, which only partially overlaps the SFA licensed range through #B2-242. Exact full-range crosswalk is not established; hold.

limitations: Only four new high-confidence name fills were proposed from these two current directories; other Jewel blank-name rows were held for stale evidence or partial unit overlap.
Name proposals do not establish that SFA records remain in force, and do not change public-access or closure classification.
No paid sources or APIs were used; the workbook was not edited.
